nodes.label: Incremental Update (--update)
nodes.rationale: Only re-extracts new or changed files to save tokens and time; deleted files are pruned, and the manifest is saved so the next update diffs against today's state instead of the prior baseline.

nodes.label: build_merge Replace-on-Re-extract
nodes.rationale: Reads graph.json directly without a NetworkX round-trip so edge direction is preserved (#801); every source_file in new chunks is dropped from the base before merge so stale nodes don't survive (#1344); prune_sources is only for genuinely deleted files, and root= relativizes prune paths so pruning actually matches (#1361).

nodes.label: Cluster-Only Rebuild (--cluster-only)
nodes.rationale: Self-contained: re-clusters, names communities, and regenerates outputs from the existing graph. Steps 5-9 must not be re-run because their intermediate files were deleted by a prior cleanup (#1392).

nodes.label: Code-Only Change Detection
nodes.rationale: When all changed files are code, semantic extraction is skipped entirely (no LLM needed); changed video files must be transcribed first or raw media paths get fed to subagents as unreadable input (#1392).
